scope: Unscored strict-font exports of four original small-minimum sources. Authored line minima and independent font metrics determine pitch, glyph dimensions and line slots; no exact Word first-baseline coordinates are claimed. LibreOffice eligibility is measured against those authored checks. No new Word or full-suite parity claim.
